steps.content: In the fine rain, you stand facing each other, both of your "guards" nearly exhausted. Trailing behind her are several Corruptors from the Rust, likely tools she has captured along the way.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your power doesn't work on non-living beings, and it requires Mania infection to establish control, right?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Is that so?
Silver chains glint as shuttle-like crystal shards slice through the air, expertly shattering the anti-Mania cores of the mechanical guards behind you.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: They’re from the FAC, just like the ones who wounded you so gravely back then.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Did they send you here... to stand against me?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: They told you to make El a hostage?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Where did they take her?
Her voice carries an icy chill, her eyes reflecting the same wariness and hostility as that night when she had you bound.
But you stand your ground, not stepping back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was the one who took her. I hid her in a safe place—all on my own accord. I was the first to have doubts about you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've seen your true power—how you controlled and enhanced Mania-infected creatures to amass an army of Puppets.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You saved me with that power—the same one you used to capture Underground Puppets, break into the cabinet, and kill Elvira's father.
She freezes for a moment, then lowers her eyes.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...So you were conscious then, and I never noticed...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Had I been more careful...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: No, how could I... You were so hurt, I couldn't possibly stay calm then.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I can't bear to see you hurt again...
She truly is a gentle soul. Even now, her soft-spoken words carry genuine concern for you.
How deceiving appearances can be. You must hold onto every piece of evidence to avoid falling into this trap.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...That memory has been hazy. I kept wishing that I was mistaken about you, especially since you fought so hard to save me. I really wanted to believe in your innocence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But then I found other evidence, and piece by piece, I uncovered the culprit's true intentions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Every slain cabinet member was quickly replaced, with their successors carrying on with the same policies and protecting the same hidden interests. Stewart, as a mere pawn in the game, even his death meant nothing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Business continues, and nothing has changed. All that carefully orchestrated violence has achieved nothing, with one exception—

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Chief Guillotin of the Outland Affairs Bureau.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: He's been extremely rigid against the Outlands—rejecting immigrants and investments, tightening restrictions even further during the election season. His successors will continue down the same path, same attitude toward outsiders like those in power in DisCity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: On the flip side, the Outland Affairs Bureau ranks low in the cabinet's hierarchy with little opportunity for graft. Those people deem it insignificant, and as a result...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: During this power vacuum before the appointment of Guillotine's successor, Outland capital has made its way into DisCity, its sight set on both the successor candidates of OAB and Max King, a political layman susceptible to control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Outlands are indeed aiming to meddle in the election, having also wormed their way into the Outland Affairs Bureau. If the 9th Agency hadn't been busy investigating those "Underground Puppets," they could have kept a closer eye on the Outland forces.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Using the Underground to assassinate the Prime Minister was merely a play. And you did it during the election, all to throw off our investigation and hide your actual goal. Is that right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, it's about time we have an honest conversation. Tell me about your handlers, and your real purpose for getting close to me.
A weighty silence descends upon you both, even the sound of the rain growing fainter.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I will, but don't use El against me. She's innocent.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've been using her all these years.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The 9th Agency screens all councilors' background, never allowing Outlanders to touch the city's core of power. But even so, you found your way in—the daughter that Stewart had kept hidden. By becoming her butler, you not only got close to her but also to your ultimate target.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And when Stewart's doomed for re-election, when he was no longer of any use to you, you killed him.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Elvira could never have imagined that you, of all people, were the one who murdered her family.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Her family?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: El was never cared for. She was not allowed to go out, or talk to anyone. She lived at the mercy of others' hands, never knowing a moment's peace.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Those vultures of the Stewarts, those bastards who treated her like a bargaining chip... are they truly her family?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: For over ten years, he never once came back to see El, no matter how she longed for his love. A man who treated her as nothing but a blemish on his reputation—can he truly be called a father?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: If people like that can be called her family, then... why can't I?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Playing "mother" does help you win trust, but for someone with blood-stained hands like you, do you really want family or just an excuse?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Hah... I asked myself the same question.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Beyond DisCity's sight, settlements struggle against calamities. We fight desperately to survive. Of course, we all yearn for family. I want to be a mother. In a world of death, only mothers can bring life.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: The disasters ravaged my body—I can never bear children of my own. Yet those orphaned children embraced me, making me whole. Some of them blossomed into strength and resilience, much like you have.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...But they forever lost their chance to grow up.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: The calamities grew more and more, corrosive rains eating away at everything, destroying my homeland. Our Hypercubes ran dry, and all our resources were taken away. DisCity's prosperity demands money, so they took it from us.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Ironically, in his final days, Mr. Stewart sought to see his daughter, hoping to rekindle their bond. He was resolute in his desire to win the election, all for El's sake.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: He planned a birthday party for her, the same day he passed the Nirvana price bill—all because his campaign needed money.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: See, Chief? Even those with blood-stained hands can have a heart. They can love. They just choose carefully who deserves their love... That's what DisCity has taught me.
As she speaks, she raises her eyes to meet yours, a faint smile gracing her face.

Suddenly, the sheet of rain, glowing with an eerie cyan light, gusts past the FAC mechanical guards. Their metal armor, having survived years of front-line defense against Mania, dissolves rapidly. Also showered by the rain, you are engulfed by waves of dizziness that leave you momentarily paralyzed.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Change of plan, the enemy Sinner is out of control! Abandon defense, all units on the offensive! Get Chief back!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop, Jelena! Don't use your Mania power!
Red light from the shackles pierces out from her body, but only for a moment.

The rain hasn't stopped. Instead, the light piercing through Jelena begins to dissolve. You feel the connection between you two fading as her Mania power undergoes a transformation. Another more dominant force is gradually seizing control of this Sinner.
Meanwhile, in her palm, a blue crystal slowly rises, emanating an eerie glow.
A large-scale anomaly, a power distinct from human Mania... This sensation is not entirely foreign to you. You have encountered crystal energy like this before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is... the Apostle of Ashes?! You are using an Ash Crystal to control its power?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: This very calamity once destroyed my homeland, but now I've made its power my own.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Worry not, Chief. I've long since let go of my hatred. I care as little for your election as they have ever cared for us.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Yet, I am deeply grateful to have found a child here who would hold me in her embrace.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: After my mission is complete, my only wish is to protect her.
The rain streams across your body, heightening your senses, alternating between scalding and freezing. Before you realize it, your body begins involuntarily walking towards her.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I don't want to hurt you. Looking at you reminds me of the children who never had the chance to grow up... I wish you could come with me.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: However, as children grow up, they find their own path. You’ve already found yours, so I know you won’t come.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: But please... return El to me.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: There's no place for her here. I must take her away, and for that, I need your help.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Please be my hostage, Chief. After all, I don't have any choice.
